title: RV32I Instruction Decoder
constraints: Decode by `opcode = instr[6:0]`. `fmt`: R = 0, I = 1, S = 2, B = 3, U = 4, J = 5, unknown opcode = 7.
`imm` is the sign-extended immediate of the instruction's format (0 for R-type and unknown opcodes).
Controls: `reg_write` for OP, OP-IMM, LOAD, LUI, AUIPC, JAL, JALR. `mem_read` for LOAD, `mem_write` for STORE, `branch` for BRANCH, `jump` for JAL and JALR. All 0 for unknown opcodes.
hints: S-imm = `{instr[31:25], instr[11:7]}`. B-imm = `{instr[31], instr[7], instr[30:25], instr[11:8], 0}`. J-imm = `{instr[31], instr[19:12], instr[20], instr[30:21], 0}`. U-imm = `{instr[31:12], 12'b0}`.
Every immediate except U is sign-extended from `instr[31]`.
